preview.text: United Arab Emirates play Oman at ICC Academy Ground. In 14 recorded one-day meetings, United Arab Emirates have won 7 and Oman 6. Oman won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours gives up to a 0 per cent chance of rain, at about 29 degrees.

summary.text: United Arab Emirates won by 42 runs. UAE made 226-8, Adeeb Usmani (wk) top-scoring with 47 off 53 balls; Shakeel Ahmed took 3 for 42. OMAN made 184-9, Mujibur Ali top-scoring with 65 off 84 balls; Muhammad Rohid Khan took 2 for 21.
